title: Hai Salaam us pe jo qaidi bhi hai
body:
Hai Salaam Us Pe Jo Qaidi Bhi Hai Bemaar Bhi Hai
Paao'n Me Aable Hain Aabloun Me qaar Bhi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehta Tha Touq-E Giraan Tu Hai Mere Hisse Me
Warna Is Fouj Me Khanjar Bhi Hai Talwaar Bhi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Poochaa Ek Shaqs Ne Shabbir Tera Kaun Hai
Roke Farmaane Lage Baba Bhi Hai Sardaar Bhi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pahonche Nazdeek Jo Laashe Ke Sakina Ne Kaha
Yeh Mere Baba Ka Bhaai Bhi Hai Alamdaar Bhi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pahonche Nazdeek Jo Koofe Ke Toh Boli Zainab
Sar Bhi Uriyaan Hai, Balwaa Bhi Hai Bazaar Bhi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dum Ruk Jaata Hai Aur Sar Bhi Jhuk Jaata Hai
Touq Yeh Tangh Nihaayat Bhi Hai Garaa'n baar Bhi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Gar Che Beemaar Hoo'n Par Zor-E Imaamat Ke Sabab
Oontt Bhi Khenchta Hoo'n Taaqath-E Raftaar Bhi Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Inhe Shimr Nazar Aata Toh Ro Ro Kehte
Yeh Sitamgar Bhi Hai Qaatil Bhi Hai Khoonkhaar Bhi Hai
